tools.description: Bring the app to the front for the person, starting it if it is not running, and open one of its pages.

page.description: The page to open: about (About device: Device name, model, software version, kernel, hardware and legal notices.); accounts (Accounts: CardDAV and CalDAV accounts that sync contacts and calendars: adding, syncing and removing.); ambience (Ambience: Wallpaper and theme.); android (Android apps: Whether Android is running, starting it at login, Google services (microG), push messages and resetting it.); androidaccess (Special access: What Android apps may do beyond their permissions: all files, installing apps, alarms and more.); androidapps (Android apps list: Each Android app's permissions, notifications, battery use and storage.); apn (Access point (APN): The mobile data access point: the carrier's own or one you enter.); appmanager (Installed apps: Each installed app's details: version, notifications, permissions, uninstalling, disabling and force stop.); appsort (App grid: Columns on the app grid, hiding desktop apps, searching native apps and notification badges.); assistkey (Assistant key: What pressing and holding the key between the volume keys does.); battery (Battery: Charge, time left, the power profile (performance, balanced, power saver) and battery history.); bluetooth (Bluetooth: Turning Bluetooth on or off, pairing, connecting and removing devices.); cellular (Mobile network: Mobile data, data roaming, network mode, the operator and signal.); datetime (Date and time: Automatic time, the time and date, 24-hour clock, units, and automatic time zone.); developer (Developer tools: Remote connection over SSH, its password, and sharing a bug report.); display (Display: Brightness, automatic brightness, night light, nightshade, screen timeout, auto-rotate, interface size and reduce motion.); erase (Erase all content: Erasing everything and starting again as new: a factory reset.); hiddenapps (Hidden apps: Which apps are hidden from the app grid.); keyboard (Keyboard: Languages, auto-correct, auto-capitalize, word predictions, vibrate on key press and speed keys.); licenses (Open source licenses: The licenses of the open source components in this build.); mms (MMS: Downloading picture and group messages automatically, and the carrier's MMS settings.); notifications (Notifications: Do not disturb, notifications on the lock screen, the notification sound and each app's notifications.); permissions (App permissions: What each app may use: camera, microphone, location, contacts and more, and the in-use indicator.); privacy (Privacy policy: Marathon OS's privacy policy: what stays on the device.); quicksettings (Quick settings: Which tiles the top menu shows, and resetting them.); savednetworks (Saved networks: The Wi-Fi networks the phone remembers, to open or forget one.); security (Security: The device lock, quick PIN, fingerprint, trackpad unlock, lock delay and data encryption.); sound (Sounds: Media volume and mute, ringtone, notification and alarm sounds and volumes, vibration and each app's volume.); speedkeys (Speed keys: The app each letter opens when held on the home screen.); storage (Storage: How much is used and how much is free.); store (App Store: Phone-only apps, the Flathub and F-Droid sources, anti-features, and automatic app updates.); themedapps (Themed apps: Whether GNOME, KDE, Android and Flatpak apps take the ambience's accent and colours.); timezone (Time zone: Choosing the time zone by city.); tos (Terms of service: Marathon OS's terms of service.); trackpad (Trackpad: Whether the keyboard's trackpad scrolls and navigates or moves a pointer.); updates (Software updates: Checking for and installing system updates, automatic updates and developer updates.); wifi (Wi-Fi: Networks nearby, joining one, hidden networks, and each network's password, auto-join, Low Data Mode, private address, IP and DNS.).
